fee_notes: Royalty: 6% of Gross Revenue or $1,500/month minimum, whichever greater. Brand Fund tiered: 1.5% of first $5M, 1.25% of $5M–$10M, 1% of $10M–$15M, 0.75% of $15M–$20M, 0% above $20M. Local Marketing: required 6% spend (typically direct to vendors). Technology: $100/month base (covers email, software, portals). Additional fees: grand opening marketing ($0–$18k), conference ($0–$1k/attendee), training ($1.5k/trainee remedial/optional), renewal ($5k), transfer ($10k+ or % of price), late fees, interest (12% p.a.).
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee: 6% of Gross Revenue or $1,500 per month (the 'Minimum Royalty'), whichever is greater. Brand Fund: 1.5% of first $5M, tiered down to 0% above $20M. Local Marketing: 6% of calendar year Gross Revenue required. Technology Fee: Currently $100 per month.
